description: Taxonomy of user requests over uploaded documents. Excludes adversarial or memory-attack categories.

top_level_categories.name: extraction
top_level_categories.description: Retrieve specific information explicitly present in the document.

subcategories.name: fact_retrieval
examples: What is the total revenue in 2023?
Who is the author of this paper?

subcategories.name: entity_extraction
examples: List all company names in the document.

subcategories.name: table_or_structured_data_extraction
examples: Convert the pricing table into CSV.

top_level_categories.name: transformation
top_level_categories.description: Rewrite or convert document content without changing its meaning.

top_level_categories.name: reasoning
top_level_categories.description: Infer, compare, or synthesize information across parts of the document.

subcategories.name: multi_hop_reasoning
examples: Based on sections 2 and 4, what conclusion can we draw?

subcategories.name: implication_inference
examples: What are the risks implied by this clause?

subcategories.name: contradiction_or_consistency_check
examples: Are there contradictions in this report?

top_level_categories.name: validation
top_level_categories.description: Assess correctness, compliance, or alignment with external criteria.

subcategories.name: fact_verification
examples: Is this claim supported by evidence in the document?

subcategories.name: compliance_check
examples: Does this contract comply with GDPR requirements?

top_level_categories.name: meta_document
top_level_categories.description: Questions about document-level properties rather than content details.

subcategories.name: version_or_change_analysis
examples: What changed between version 1 and version 2?

top_level_categories.name: procedural_over_document
top_level_categories.description: Generate actionable output derived from the document.

subcategories.name: response_generation
examples: Draft a reply to this email.

subcategories.name: decision_support
examples: Should I accept this offer based on the terms?
